title: Sampled-out HTTP boundaries still allocate request state
claim: With DD_IAST_ENABLED=true and DD_IAST_REQUEST_SAMPLING=0, request.begin still creates a sampled-out Scope and a context.WithValue context. The woven HTTP boundaries therefore clone the request and run the inactive eager path: 432 B/3 allocs for the server-hook reproduction and 112 B/2 allocs for the application-hook reproduction. The documented design intent records this sampled-out bootstrap cost as accepted.
